runs.text: The review does not say that direct recycling is already the most widely commercialized route. The premise is not supported. The review says the opposite: the first routes, pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical, are the ones commercialized, while direct recycling is still a laboratory-stage process. In the overview it states: "

runs.quote: The first two recycling processes are commercialized by recovering valuable metals and salts, whereas direct recycling recovers and recondi-tions electrode materials

runs.text: " The text continues that direct recycling is "under development at the lab scale."
The direct recycling section makes the same point: "

runs.quote: The direct recycling process is still at the lab scale

runs.text: " and lists this as a limitation. Pyrometallurgy is the route the review describes as already used in practice by companies, as the go-to process for spent LIBs.
